question: Who among the following sportspersons won the Hockey India Dhruv Batra Player of the Year Award 2019 for Men?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manpreet Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manpreet Singh **and **Rani **won the **Hockey India Dhruv Batra Player **of the **Year Award 2019 **for **Men and Women respectively**, at the **Hockey India 3rd Annual Awards 2019**.
 
• ​​**Manpreet Singh **is one of **India’s best field hockey players **and the **captain of the Indian men’s hockey team**.
 
• **In 2018, **he was given the **Arjuna Award**, the highest honour bestowed given to a sportsperson by the Indian government.
 
• **In 2019**, he was named the **best men’s player **at the **FIH Player **of the Year Awards.
 
• At **Tokyo 2020**, he led India to a **bronze medal**, ending a **wait of 41 years **for an **Olympic medal in hockey**.
 
• Later **in 2021**, he was awarded the **Khel Ratna**, the highest honour given to **sportspersons in India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harmanpreet Singh**

 
 
• Hockey India Pargat Singh award for defender of the year 2019.
 
 
 
• **PR Sreejesh**
 
 
• **Khel ratna** award 2021.
 
• World Athlete of the year 2021.
 
 
 
• **Rupinder Pal Singh**
 
 
• He was a part of the Indian Hockey team that won a Bronze medal at the 2020 Olympic Games in Tokyo.
